about.text: We both carry out industrial work ourselves and supply qualified professionals, supporting companies and projects that need specialist technical support. foreman_piping.title: Piping Foreman
foreman_piping.shortDesc: Supervision of industrial piping assembly. European documentation required.
foreman_piping.longDesc: We are looking for a Piping Foreman for a long-term project. Duties: leading teams, reading isometric drawings, and ensuring deadlines are met. Required: Valid European documentation and proven experience in the role.

welders_general.shortDesc: Qualified welders for a stable, long-term project.
welders_general.longDesc: We are recruiting Welders with proven experience. Extended project with stable working conditions. Required: Authorization to work in the EU.

helpers_ribatejo.shortDesc: Assembly support and general work. Short-term contract with accommodation included.
helpers_ribatejo.longDesc: Multi-skilled Helpers for work in the Ribatejo area. Short-term contract (approx. 1 week). Conditions: Travel costs covered + Accommodation + Meals included. Immediate start.

pipefitters_general.title: Pipefitters
pipefitters_general.longDesc: Pipefitters with proven assembly experience. European documentation required. Placement on ongoing projects.

tig_inox_setubal.shortDesc: TIG welding on stainless steel. Certification an advantage.

legalBasis.text: The processing of your personal data is based on your explicit consent, given by accepting this policy when submitting forms on our site, in accordance with Article 6(1)(a) of the GDPR.

retention.text: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected. Contact data is kept for a maximum of 24 months. Application data is kept for a maximum of 12 months after the selection process.

sharing.title: 6. Data Sharing
sharing.text: Your personal data is not sold, shared, or transferred to third parties, except when strictly necessary for the services provided (e.g., website hosting, email service) or when required by law.

rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:

authority.title: 9. Supervisory Authority
authority.text: If you consider that the processing of your data violates the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese Data Protection Authority (CNPD).
